notes.title: Nov 12, 2022 - Fixes and a Couple Changes!
notes.notes:
Features:
Lowered salvage cost from 100 to 25 gold
Added preview of available Salvage items 

Fixes:
Level 9+ of Dark Eternal did not work
typing L at naming character can cause a popup to display
webgl player profile didnt update after logging in with third party
Opening Chests on rare occasion errors out
Insight Manna boost not displaying bonus in game
Fixed coin flip sometimes not activating on rare conditions

notes.notes:
I have just updated the game with Duel Leaderboards and now playable on MacOS! 
If there are any questions or suggestions - please feel to reach out!

notes.title: August/Sept Update! Luminary Pass - The Dark Eternal Delve!
notes.notes:
I have added a few things over the month or so that I have been working on things. 
A completely new battle and reward system!

+ Added Duel Quests
+ Better Quest Chest Rewards
+ Added Better Delve Chest rewards
+ Fixed Opening Chests and Revealing Scrolls
+ Forge: Hover displays name of item

  If you find any issues please feel free to message me on here or discord 
thanks alot and hope you enjoy!
